testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle a panel from the ribbon panel selector: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:181:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle a panel from the ribbon panel selector ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top ✔ And the Parameters panel is hidden ✔ When the user clicks the panel selector at the right end of the ribbon ✔ Then the panel list opens with Parameters unchecked ✔ When the user selects Parameters in the list ✔ Then Parameters is checked and its panel appears in the ribbon ✔ And the panel list remains open ✔ When the user selects Parameters again ✔ Then Parameters is unchecked and its panel disappears ✔ And the panel list remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the panel list closes
